pool.text: Awadh became part of the Sharqi Sultanate of Jaunpur for eighty-four years
Emperor Humayun made the area a part of the Mughal Empire
Saadat Khan was appointed Nizam of Awadh and established his court
The fourth Nawab Asaf-ud-Daula shifted his court to Lucknow from Faizabad
Bara Imambara in Hussainabad was built by the Nawab Asaf-ud-Daula
The fifth Nawab Wazir Ali Khan was forced to abdicate power
Dilkusha Kothi was constructed by the British resident Major Gore Ouseley
A treaty made the state of Awadh a vassal of the company
Dyer Breweries was incorporated as Asia's first commercial brewery
An All India Radio station has been operational in the city
Lucknow became independent from Britain along with the rest of India
The government changed the municipal system to an administrator run one
The city became the headquarters of the Central Command of the Indian Army
The company name was changed to Mohan Meakin Brewery
Sangeet Natak Akademy was set up by the government of Uttar Pradesh
The government of Uttar Pradesh banned public Azadari processions
The ban on public Azadari processions was partially lifted
FM radio transmission started in Lucknow with multiple stations
Software Technology Parks of India was set up by the ministry
Geographical Indication status was accorded for chikankari manufacture
